subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu plugin send message fails with 400 error - receive_id_type is required

question: Should maintainers require fresh Feishu/Lark live diagnostics before reviving or replacing the open fork PR for this send failure?
rationale: Source inspection shows a suspicious target-resolution fallback, but the current send call and SDK contract already include `receive_id_type`, and the reporter's manual API call also failed, so the exact failure mode is not proven.

options.title: Require fresh Feishu proof
options.body: Ask for latest-release or current-main logs with redacted target shape, vendor error body, and `log_id` before adopting or replacing the fork PR.

options.title: Adopt the fork with repairs
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers accept the nullable resolver direction and require conflict resolution, type fixes, regression tests, and real Feishu proof before merge.

options.title: Close as external setup if proven
options.body: If fresh diagnostics show Feishu app/API setup rather than OpenClaw routing is responsible, close this as not actionable with the diagnostic path documented.

recommendation.title: Require fresh Feishu proof
recommendation.body: Ask for latest-release or current-main logs with redacted target shape, vendor error body, and `log_id` before adopting or replacing the fork PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata identifies this handle as the Feishu/Lark plugin domain contact, making them the best available reviewer for receive-id semantics.
